counts.coarse_groups_definition: Transolver, FLARE, GeoTransolver (includingGALE_FA+temporal), MeshGraphNet (includingHybridMeshGraphNet), FIGConvUNet; a reporting taxonomy, not a claim of theoretical independence.
counts.ROM_physical_case_families_definition: Coupon, bumper, phone. Phone rear is a support slice of the same9FEMcases, not a new physical dataset.

counting_rules: One fit artifact is one completed dataset/support/target+configuration+seed training; file copies, validation roundtrips, checkpoint reloads and evaluation passes add zero fits.

Configuration/seed sweeps add runs, not new algorithm families. GALE_FA is GeoTransolver attention backend; temporal strategies reuse GeoTransolver; Plate noise0 is sensitivity of one reduced HybridMeshGraphNet.
B1/Batch/Plate Adam smoke probes are functionality/resource checks, excluded from accuracy-training artifact counts.
POD+RBF and POD+Ridge share a train decomposition per support. Different ranks/predictors do not double the underlying basis fit; reloads do not refit it.

Final ROM methods3 x supports4 gives12predictor artifacts, not12algorithm families or12independent physical datasets. Historical curated3 remains separate. Phone rank4 POD+RBF and directRBF span all positive train modes and are numerically equivalent here, not independent superiority evidence.
No universal count of all research training is claimed. This ledger is restricted to the source crosswalk and local expanded benchmark evidence listed.
All completion counts are metadata snapshots at as_of_utc. Later completions require a new audit; pending paths are never promoted from preparation.

stage_summary.Sinter_BIW_legacySym_structuralFNO: No completed data-specific training/FEM accuracy evidence in this scoped inventory; blockers are explicit below.

blockers: Pinned recipe mentions local train/test TFRecord, metadata and checkpoint paths but verified public download was not located. This is not a claim that no public data exists anywhere.
VFGN predicts acceleration then positions, without stress/strain heads. Existing bumper/phone/coupon outputs do not replace temperature-conditioned densification trajectories.
Recorded source audit flags next_positions rank mismatch and version-specific scheduler/API handling; full dependency/model runtime remains unverified.
pending_or_unexecuted_blockers.feasibility_without_paid_compute_or_new_: Existing public structural datasets cannot close the missing sintering-data task. A reduced CPU synthetic graph smoke test may be possible after engineering/dependency work, but would establish only interface operation. Actual sintering validation still needs suitable temperature/position-history data and reference outputs. No new paid GPU is established as necessary or sufficient.

blockers: Two official one-shot GeoTransolver/GALE_FA configurations exist, but the checked sources did not provide a verified full BIW FEM deck and 150-case result dataset download.
Bumper, coupon and phone functionality prove shared class operation only; they are different geometry, loading and input contracts.
pending_or_unexecuted_blockers.feasibility_without_paid_compute_or_new_: Cannot claim the official BIW task solved with current local public examples. Existing six-class runtime evidence reduces software uncertainty, but does not supply BIW geometry/labels. A different public thin-shell model or synthetic mesh would be a new task requiring an explicit adapter and reference calculation.

blockers: Examples belong to a distinct archived repository/API; current core symbolic migration removes legacy Solver/Domain/prebuilt PDE interfaces. Installed core does not establish legacy Sym installation success.
Default 6x512 networks and 1M/2M-step settings have no local resource measurement.
Bracket commercial-solver supplemental reference availability was not verified; supplemental data is not a pretrained checkpoint.
pending_or_unexecuted_blockers.feasibility_without_paid_compute_or_new_: A small CPU PINN/VPINN on an analytic plane domain is a plausible engineering path using PDE/BC source and analytic/Q1 references already available; this is an inference, not executed evidence. It requires a legacy compatible environment or a current-API port, training time and separate validation. It does not reproduce full bracket/panel settings or impact/plasticity.

blockers: Pinned elasticity path uses Q1 finite elements/BiCGSTAB and decomposition; it does not instantiate an elasticity FNO. A transitive thermal/FNO import is not structural neural training.
Actual local execution validates the unchanged Q1 solver component on two problems, not the complete2x2 decomposition comparison.
pending_or_unexecuted_blockers.feasibility_without_paid_compute_or_new_: The self-generated elasticity example has no missing external dataset, so a bounded full numerical DDM CPU check appears feasible after dependency/resource preflight; not executed here. A new structural FNO benchmark could use newly generated Q1 fields and a small CPU model, but requires new dataset/architecture/training work and is outside the existing official structural recipe. No existing coupon/crash fit can count as that execution.

pending_or_unexecuted_blockers.item: Official-capacity Plate128x15 and new phone/bumper temporal profiles
blockers: Plate128x15 has actual5Adam functionality/resource evidence, but no completed final accuracy training metadata; official32 preparation/audit is not execution.
Phone/bumper temporal prepared contracts and wrapper compatibility do not supply domain-specific completed fits. Original AR/TF remains C3, not direct stress/strain.
pending_or_unexecuted_blockers.feasibility_without_paid_compute_or_new_: Public Plate trajectories and local structural labels already exist; the remaining barriers are host RAM, measured compute time and execution of frozen protocols. Existing GPU fits the Plate capacity probe, but accuracy/convergence are unproven. CPU or sequential use of the already owned GPU may avoid extra hardware cost; no zero-time/zero-engineering promise.

independent_audit_caution.meaning: Metadata/integrity pass is not the same as independent metric recomputation; record audit pass is not an appliance-useful-accuracy certificate.

limitations: This audit trusts recorded completed source/metric audits; it does not reopen arrays or rerun their math.
Pinned code/papers are linked from the stored primary-source investigation. No claim about the newest upstream availability was introduced and no fresh web search was needed.
No claim of all-algorithm completion, converged training, full-drop peak/rebound, new geometry generalization, original solver strain forPlate, or structural FNO fromQ1.
